Forward Filter for the scalar-sigma-squared-times-R model

Source: R/func_FF.R
FF_sigma2R.Rd

Runs the full forward filtering pass over nT time steps under the model where the right covariance of \(Y\) is \(\sigma^2 R\) with \(\sigma^2 \sim IG(n_0, d_0)\).

Usage

FF_sigma2R(
  Y,
  F_ls,
  G_ls,
  W_ls,
  V_ls,
  m0,
  M0,
  n0,
  D0,
  nT,
  R,
  delta = 1,
  verbose = FALSE
)

Arguments

Y

List of length nT. Each element is the \(N \times S\) data matrix at the corresponding time step.

F_ls

Covariate matrix or list of matrices (see FF).

G_ls

State transition matrix or list (see FF).

W_ls

State noise left-covariance matrix or list (see FF).

V_ls

Observation noise left-covariance matrix or list (see FF).

m0

Numeric matrix. Prior state mean (\(p \times S\)).

M0

Numeric matrix. Prior state left-covariance (\(p \times p\)).

n0

Numeric scalar. Prior shape of \(\sigma^2\).

D0

Numeric scalar. Prior rate of \(\sigma^2\).

nT

Integer. Number of time steps.

R

Numeric matrix. Fixed spatial correlation matrix (\(S \times S\)). Its Cholesky inverse is used internally.

delta

Discount factor. Not implemented: values other than 1 give a warning and are ignored. Defaults to 1.

verbose

Logical. If TRUE, emits progress messages. Defaults to FALSE.

Value

A named list of length nT + 1 (same structure as FF) with an additional scalar Dt in place of a matrix.

See also

FF_1step_R_sigma2R, FFBS_sigma2R

Examples

set.seed(1)
dat <- gen_ffbs_data(N = 5, S = 3, p = 2, nT = 4)
par <- dat$para
R <- 0.5^abs(outer(1:3, 1:3, "-"))
res_ff <- FF_sigma2R(dat$Y, par$F0, par$G0, par$W0, par$V0, par$m0, par$M0,
                     n0 = 3, D0 = 1, nT = 4, R = R)
c(nt = res_ff$T4$nt, Dt = res_ff$T4$Dt)  # IG posterior of sigma^2
#>        nt        Dt 
#> 33.000000  6.012184
